annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027'
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 62
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's proposal for the Digital Europe programme 2021-2027 (EUR 9.2bn). It welcomes funding for HPC, AI, cybersecurity and digital skills, urges inclusive distribution of the digital dividend, and calls for the 'human in command' principle, ethical compliance, and clear AI liability rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Supports a higher budget for digital skills (EUR 830m, 9%).
Calls for 'human in command' principle in AI, especially in the workplace.
Asks for clear legal guidance on liability for AI and automated systems.
Demands inclusive digitalisation and fair distribution of the digital dividend.
Wants social partners and civil society involved in digital innovation hubs.
